name: Émile Gaudreault
bio: Émile Gaudreault (born March 6, 1964) is a Canadian film director and screenwriter, whose credits include the films Louis 19, le roi des ondes, Nuit de noces, Mambo Italiano, Surviving My Mother and De père en flic.
